tools.name: acorn_public_catalog
tools.description: Read nine canonical professional services, three small-scope entry proposals and currently listed fixed-price Stripe-hosted products. Links for humans only; no charge, authentication or private access.

tools.name: acorn_request_link
tools.description: Get an official ACORN public free enquiry URL. This does not create a lead, order or payment.

tools.name: acorn_commercial_boundaries
tools.description: Read public capabilities, safety and checkout limits. No operational access.

tools.name: acorn_find_offers
tools.description: Read current public products. Filter immediate Stripe hosted products from custom services requiring quotes; no checkout is created and no customer is identified.

tools.name: acorn_offer_details
tools.description: Read a public offer by its canonical ID. Returns exact price and customer link for fixed-price goods, or an enquiry link when a quote is required. Never charges a customer.

tools.name: acorn_hosted_checkout_link
tools.description: Returns the already-verified public Stripe URL and listed USD amount for one DIRECT offer. Requires the human customer to review and pay on Stripe. This tool never initiates a payment, buys a product, verifies payment or provides private delivery.

tools.name: acorn_recommend_offers
tools.description: Deterministic public offer matching by a short business goal, optional USD budget, delivery kind and direct/quote preference. No personal profiling, payment or final-tax calculation.

tools.name: acorn_compare_offers
tools.description: Read side-by-side canonical offer records and terms. Reject missing IDs; no invented discounts, total prices, orders or delivery guarantees.

tools.name: acorn_buyer_guide
tools.description: Public read-only purchase guide for one exact offer. Shows listed unit amount, official URL, the deliverable language, downloadable-kit contents where verified, paid-session prerequisites and remaining limitations. Never creates or verifies purchases.

tools.name: acorn_shop_assistant
tools.description: One safe, read-only call that matches a business need and optional listed-unit USD budget with real direct-buy offers, then explains contents, language, delivery proof and official human-controlled Stripe link. No checkout created or payment attempted.

tools.name: acorn_world_ai_integrations
tools.description: Read official integration routes for Claude, Gemini CLI, Copilot Studio, Mistral Studio, Grok API, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Qwen Code, Bedrock AgentCore and OpenAI API. No connector install, authorization, purchase or platform live-verification is performed.

tools.name: acorn_huggingface_search
tools.description: Bounded read-only metadata search on the public Hugging Face Hub. Does not execute, download, train, deploy or purchase models. License tags are not authorization for commercial use; verify each original resource card.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "acorn_world_ai_integrations" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
